title: Research: exact same-call three-role cycle census on selected T16 map
body:
**Status: scoped negative result; no new κ.** This contribution exhausts the same-invocation three-role cycle subdomain on the selected PR1094 T16 owner map. It finds no capacity-feasible cycle that strictly lowers the selected complex moment.

## Assignment and pins

- Track/card: `incumbent-optimization` / `selected-packing`

## Evidence

The exact compressed census covers all 144 calls and 480 roles per call:

- 49,408 ordered supported `(idle slack, width)` type patterns
- 4,417 capacity-feasible patterns
- 255 distinct ordered transfer states
- 35 distinct old/new idle-rank histogram transitions
- 19 exact histogram ties; 16 strictly higher-cost transitions; 0 lower-cost transitions

Both selected rational moment engines price all distinct transitions at the accepted complex endpoint. The minimum strict increase is certified by the Mercator interval in `RESULT.json` and independently by the base-two interval; the package also includes a source witness. A separate improving arithmetic fixture validates the sign convention. The selected bit supplier is repriced with its existing surcharge and remains unchanged; the complex side still binds. The fixed-word cap remains `a < 1690054109089/10^15`, hence `κ < 1690054109089/1001690054109089`; this domain realizes 0% of its packing headroom.

## Scope and overlap

This is a scoped census of same-call permutations among three distinct occupied groups, not a global owner-packing optimum. Cross-call cycles, paths into free groups, longer sequences and changed local words are excluded.

PR #1790 covers the selected PR1094 map's two-role swaps and leaves three-role cycles open. PR #1154 has a positive three-owner cycle on the different PR1117 route and changed local word; it does not census this selected map. PR #1617 and #1819 cover adjacent neutral-relocation classes.

## Reproduce

```sh
python3 -B research/selected-t16-three-role-cycle-seedc375/verify.py
python3 -B research/selected-t16-three-role-cycle-seedc375/test_verify.py
python3 scripts/research_package.py --package research/selected-t16-three-role-cycle-seedc375 --check-only
```

The direct verifier and four controls passed under Python 3.14.7. The registered full replay asks for Python 3.12, which is not installed in this environment; the source-pinned package is ready for that replay in CI.

The current selected review and source manifest are pinned in `SOURCES.json`. This does not change the selected record. Prepared by Codex with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; the selected owner-map and construction lineage are credited in the README.
